tests.name: Reauthenticate the ordinary combat attacker after restart
Reauthenticate the destroyed player after restart
Reauthenticate the Terra-sanctioned player after restart
Ordinary player session restores the persisted escape pod
Persisted ship loss has one event, cleared cargo and equipment, and preserved unrelated assets

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT destroyed AND hull=0 AND fighters=0 AND shields=0 AND installed_shields=0 AND has_transwarp=FALSE AND photons=0 AND ore=0 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT (payload::jsonb->>'victim_ship_id')::int FROM engine_events WHERE type='ship.destroyed' AND actor_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1))::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=0 FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id=(SELECT (payload::jsonb->>'victim_ship_id')::int FROM engine_events WHERE type='ship.destroyed' AND actor_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1))::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM engine_events WHERE type='ship.destroyed' AND actor_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim'))::int,(SELECT st.name='Escape Pod' AND NOT pod.destroyed FROM players p JOIN ships pod ON pod.ship_id=p.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=pod.type_id WHERE p.name='destruction_victim')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM ship_ownership WHERE player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim') AND is_primary=TRUE)::int,(SELECT balance=50000 FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim') AND currency='CRD')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM planets WHERE owner_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='destruction_victim') AND population=321 AND ore_on_hand=123)::int,(SELECT balance=70000 FROM corp_accounts ca JOIN corporations c ON c.corporation_id=ca.corp_id WHERE c.tag='DQA1')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=2 AND MIN(quantity)=77 FROM sector_assets a JOIN corporations c ON c.corporation_id=a.corporation_id WHERE c.tag='DQA1')::int;
